title: HuneX
text:
HuneX is a video game developer formed as a partnership between NEC Home Electronics, Ltd. and Human in 1992. HuneX mainly produces Bishōjo games and Otome games.

 Overview 
Established in October 1992 as a game software development subsidiary of NEC Home Electronics and Human, it initially developed PC Engine titles. At the time of its establishment, Human held a 51% stake and NEC Home Electronics held 49%. The company had 20 employees at the time of its establishment. The company was located in the same building as Human, and the president was also the president of Human, Choshiro Suzuki.

Since 2014, the brand has been operating under the name "dramatic create."
